title: Bleams Road rezoning and Benton Street leases
subtitle: Council approved two retail leases at 26 and 28 Benton Street and met briefly before a committee session.
overview: A short special meeting of Council approved a Zoning By-law Amendment for 1385 Bleams Road {{vote:m1}}. The item came from the Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee earlier the same day, and Council added a by-law to the agenda so the zoning change could be finalized right away.

Following a closed session, Council authorized the Mayor and Clerk to sign leases for two City-owned retail spaces on Benton Street. One is at 26 Benton Street with a catering company {{vote:m3}}. The other is at 28 Benton Street with a company yet to be incorporated {{vote:m4}}. Both agreements must satisfy the City Solicitor. The leases put City-owned retail space in use.

Council also held a closed meeting on two land disposition matters and passed the by-law confirming its actions. No delegates appeared. The Acting Mayor chaired, as the Mayor and one councillor were absent. The meeting ended quickly so the committee meeting could resume.

decisions.detail: Council approved the Zoning By-law Amendment to By-law 85-1 for 1385 Bleams Road, as set out in report DSD-2023-153 {{vote:m1}}.
Council authorized the Mayor and Clerk to sign a lease with La Lola Catering Inc for the retail space at 26 Benton Street, subject to the City Solicitor's satisfaction {{vote:m3}}.
Council authorized the Mayor and Clerk to sign a lease for the retail space at 28 Benton Street with a company to be incorporated, subject to the City Solicitor's satisfaction {{vote:m4}}.
